EmailTemplate.name: Welcome to Qantas Salesforce
EmailTemplate.subject: Welcome to Qantas Salesforce
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Case.First_Name__c},
Your access to Salesforce has been set up.
Please find the link to Quick Reference Guide containing instructions on how to log into Salesforce.
Kindly let us know if you have any queries or issues accessing Salesforce.
Please note: if you have not signed into The Terminal and set up multi-factor authentication, please do so before trying to log into Salesforce.
Thanks, Salesforce Business Connect Team
